note: Small lakeside campground in Buck Lake Provincial Recreation Area. Sites are in an open area but well treed, close to the lake and the canal; boat launch and fish-cleaning station. No firewood is sold on site. A second unit, where the site allows one, is paid for on site by cash or cheque. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 6, 2026) and campground map read. Confirmed first-come only, 20 unserviced sites at $28, season May 14 - Sep 21 (2026), vault toilets, non-potable pump, phone 780-586-2644 (the campground booth). No 2027 dates, maximum unit length or dump station posted.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakefront; recommend a downgrade): the agency says sites 'are close to the lake and irrigation canal', not on the shore. Its campground map shows the sites around a large parking lot and along a road west of it. On Esri imagery the lot is 150-200 m from open lake water across marsh and willow; the nearest water is the outlet canal (about 20 m wide), 40-80 m from the north-east sites with trees between (imagery estimates). Nothing supports lakefront; with no view shown in agency photos this reads not waterfront.

POLICY ROW (provincial:AB): the page says 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' The row carries no seniors discount.
